Dawn: fewer zombies until nightfall.
Kid 3 recovered and returned.
New lead: Military Checkpoint (High risk, 5 h trip). Open Explore to send a squad. It's gone in about 10 hours.
📻 Dusk Radio: Morning. Coffee ran out years ago. We are all just like this now. Between you and me: rain Barrel has no Farmer: change someone's profession.
📻 Dusk Radio: A trader's coming. Prices are terrible, but so is everything.
